svg.aria-label: Cumulative contributions 2014–2026: 9,789 total, highest so far 5,311 in 2026, shown as annual bars with a running cumulative total curve. 2014 to 2022 are grouped into one stacked bar totalling 539; average growth +193%/yr since 2023; 2026 is still in progress; 2027 is an empty placeholder for the year ahead; 2027 to 2028 are an unstarted future runway; the enlightenment phase sits between them; the visual phase motif continues into 20 rays of light with spectral fringing and winged interference bands

g.title: the golden age: singularity projectiles shatter through glass into 20 rays
